newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Italian president holds talks with King Hassan.
newsitem.headline: Italian president holds talks with King Hassan.

text.p: Italian President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro held talks with King Hassan on Wednesday in Rabat during the second day of his visit to Morocco,

No details were given of the talks, which followed a meeting with Moroccan students during which Scalfaro made a plea for an end to armed conflicts, Morocco's official news agency MAP said. Italy is trying to cope with a flood of refugees from Albania's turmoil.

In an interview with an Italian television journalist on Tuesday, the text of which was released on Wednesday, King Hassan said despite good relations with Italy there were some problems, particularly in agriculture.
"The fact that we are sometimes competitors creates reticence on Italy's part, not on the political or diplomatic level but on that of defending our reciprocal economic interests," he said.

The king also said Italians were not enterprising enough towards Morocco. "They do not invest enough, they do not come here often enough. I would like to see an extra effort made by our Italian friends on the level of our trade exchanges."
Scalfaro is due to end his visit on Thursday.
